LESSON: HADITH ON DRESSING

Grade: Grade 6
Subject: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: HADITHI
Topic 2.2: Hadith on dressing

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! Today we learn about Hadith on dressing. Read the explanation, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

Big question: Why should the male and female dress differently?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. read the Hadith on Islamic dressing for moral uprightness
2. describe the male and female dress code as per the Sunnah of the Prophet (S.A.W.)
3. practise Islamic manner of dressing as an act of ibadah

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. read the Hadith on Islamic dressing for moral uprightness
   In simple words: practise until you can read the Hadith on Islamic dressing for moral uprightness. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

2. describe the male and female dress code as per the Sunnah of the Prophet (S.A.W.)
   In simple words: practise until you can describe the male and female dress code as per the Sunnah of the Prophet (S.A.W.). Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

3. practise Islamic manner of dressing as an act of ibadah
   In simple words: practise until you can practise Islamic manner of dressing as an act of ibadah. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Talk about Hadith on dressing using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Underline two new ideas about Hadith on dressing in the examples.
2. Explain Hadith on dressing to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Hadith on dressing.
4. Show that you can: read the Hadith on Islamic dressing for moral uprightness

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Hadith on dressing using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Hadith on dressing important for a Grade 6 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 7: CLASS ACTIVITY IDEAS

1. Read the Hadith on dressing: “The Messenger of Allah (S.A.W.) cursed the man who wears women’s clothing and the woman who wears men’s clothing.” (Abu-Daud),
2. Classify clothes and accessories according to gender (trousers, skirts, blouses, shirts, shorts, necklaces, earrings, bangles, hair dressing) using digital devices/pocket boards/charts,
3. Discuss the male and female dress code as per the Sunnah of the Prophet (S.A.W.) and make class presentation,
4. Draw and colour different clothes and accessories and display, 1. Why should the male and female dress differently? 2. What is the purpose of dressing? 7
5. Search for the reasons why the Prophet (S.A.W.) prohibited gender-mixed dressing and write a short essay,

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. Why should the male and female dress differently?
2. What is the purpose of dressing?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. read the Hadith on Islamic dressing for moral uprightness
2. describe the male and female dress code as per the Sunnah of the Prophet (S.A.W.)
3. practise Islamic manner of dressing as an act of ibadah

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original learner lesson from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
